fields.title: Reference structure
fields.description: Define the reference structure to validate against by specifying the expected columns and their types.

fields.title: Set input table as template
fields.description: Sets the input table specification as reference structure template.

fields.title: If column name casing differs
fields.description:
Controls what counts as a column name match between the input table and the reference table. If
'Rename' is chosen, it still tries to treat the column name as a distinct value (find an exactly
case-sensitive matching column name) first, and then falls back to renaming the column
(case-insensitive matching).

fields.title: If a column is not in the table
fields.description:
Ensures that the configured columns exist in the input table. If case insensitive name matching
is selected, the first matching column will satisfy this condition.

choices.label: Insert with missing values and move to end

fields.title: If there is an additional column in the table
fields.description:
Specifies how to handle columns which are not included in the reference structure but present in the table
to validate.

fields.title: If data type does not match
fields.description: Ensures correct data type for the columns.

choices.value: Try to convert (reject if not compatible)
choices.label: Try to convert (reject if not compatible)

fields.title: If validation fails
fields.description: Controls how validation faults should influence the workflow execution.
